name: WOMCY - Latam Women in Cybersecurity
candidate_notes: Affinity: women; org: WOMCY; join: paid-membership; scope: security. Membership platform, not a chat community. CyberEdu tier is free-with-$1-min-donation for students (proof of enrollment required); CyberMaster $25/yr, CyberNinja $50/yr for others.

name: CryptoHarlem
candidate_notes: Affinity: bipoc; org: CryptoHarlem; join: open-link; scope: security. Digital-security/surveillance-self-defense education nonprofit for the Black community; weekly Saturday livestream discussed in Discord.

name: BlackGirlsHack (Microsoft Teams membership)
candidate_notes: Affinity: women, bipoc; org: BlackGirlsHack / BGH Foundation; join: request-form; scope: security. SAME ORG already listed on Discord (discord.gg/gCQ8Hu2CQ7) — flagging because the org's actual formal membership process now runs through Microsoft Teams via this application form, a different platform than the existing Discord listing. Applications reportedly only processed on Sundays.

name: WiCyS (Women in Cybersecurity)
candidate_notes: Affinity: women; org: WiCyS; join: paid-membership; scope: security. Large national/global nonprofit; membership grants access to a members-only community portal (womenincybersecuritywicys.my.site.com) with special interest groups. Exact fee tiers not visible in fetched text (referenced as an image 'fee chart'); likely has a reduced/free student tier but unconfirmed.

name: WISP (Women in Security and Privacy)
candidate_notes: Affinity: women; org: WISP; join: free-signup; scope: security. Site explicitly states 'no membership fees to join' and 'all are welcome.' No Slack/Discord found — the /connect page is the entry point (direct fetch of that page 404'd for us, but it was referenced from the homepage and in search results).
